trashslot.serverNotInstalled.en: The server does not have TrashSlot installed. This mod will be disabled.
trashslot.serverNotInstalled.zh: 服务器没有安装垃圾桶。此 Mod 将被禁用。

config.trashslot.instantDeletion.tooltip.en: This causes the deletion slot to delete items instantly, similar to Creative Mode.

config.trashslot.enableDeleteKeysInCreat.en: Set to true if you want the delete keybindings to work in creative as well. Note: Items will be deleted permanently in creative, regardless of instantDeletion setting!

config.trashslot.enableHints.tooltip.en: TrashSlot will show a hint the first time the trash slot is toggled off or can be enabled on a supported screen. Set to false to disable.

config.trashslot.allowDeletionWhileTrash.en: Allow Deletion While TrashSlot is Invisible
Not recommended, but this will allow you to use the keybinds for deleting items even if the trash slot itself is hidden.

config.trashslot.deletionDenyList.toolti.en: List of items that cannot be deleted, in comma-separated format of "modid:name".

trashslot.hint.toggleOn.en: Press %s to enable the trash slot for this screen!

trashslot.hint.toggledOff.en: You've toggled off the trash slot! Press %s to re-enable it.

trashslot.hint.locked.en: Trash slot locked. Press %s to unlock it.

trashslot.hint.unlocked.en: Trash slot unlocked. Press %s to lock it.
